query: What annotated MRI/4D‑flow training sets and inter‑rater reliability thresholds will we provide, and what acceptance criteria will we set for automated segmentation pipelines?

response.query: What annotated MRI/4D‑flow training sets and inter‑rater reliability thresholds will we provide, and what acceptance criteria will we set for automated segmentation pipelines?
response.answer: We will provide annotated MRI/4D-flow training sets with inter-rater reliability thresholds of 90% agreement. Acceptance criteria for automated segmentation pipelines will be 95% accuracy against expert annotations.
